tools.name: stt_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file to text (batch, not realtime). The audio comes from a local file path or a log:/mem: handle; the text is saved to the transcript list.

audio.description: Audio file path (absolute, or relative to the bot workspace) or a log:/mem: handle.

note.description: Short label for the transcript list.

language.description: Language code such as zh / en; overrides the configured hints.

context.description: Exact words (names, terms) likely spoken in the audio, in their original form; the engine matches against this text, so descriptions alone help little. Overrides the configured hint. (dashscope qwen-audio-3.x and openai only.)

summary.zh: 把一个音频文件（或 log:/mem: 句柄）转写成文字，记进转写记录并交回对话。
summary.en: Transcribe an audio file (or a log:/mem: handle) to text; the text is saved to the transcript list and returned to the conversation.
